reviews.title: Horrible customer experience
reviews.text: I downloaded and bought an annual subscription to this app due to the reviews and being highly recommended. However, I am disappointed. I am new to editing pictures, but I am only able to use this app on my phone, I have to edit each picture individually, especially when I photographed a wedding and have 3,000 pictures from that one event. Although it has me save my AI edits. What is the most frustrating aspect is there is not any options to remove red eyes. You can try to delete it or heal it, sometimes it can do an okay job, but majority of the time it makes the person’s eyes look clearly tampered with. I am not renewing my subscription, in-fact I am canceling it. I personally don’t recommend this app. You must have service or be on Wi-Fi, it will not let you edit pictures if you do not. I have contacted customer twice now. First to inform them of my original issues, to which I was advised that due to the heavy discount for the annual subscription, refunds are not permitted. Then, I had an issues the my app not working properly. Logged out and couldn’t log back in due to issues with my email account. When I contacted customer service, they found my account but did not help me in any way.

reviews.title: Lightroom 11.6.1 on iPhone: Editing Controls Greyed Out and Stuck on “Loading Editing Tools”
reviews.text:
Since updating Lightroom on my iPhone, I have been unable to edit any photos.

Lightroom version: 11.6.1
iOS version: 18.5

Photos are visible, but all editing controls, including Exposure, Contrast and Highlights, are greyed out and unresponsive. The back button still works. Newly taken photos have the same problem.

The app has shown “Importing — 1 pending” without completing. After reinstalling again, it now gets stuck on “Loading editing tools”.

I have already tried:

* Completely deleting and reinstalling the app, not just offloading it.
* Restarting my iPhone.
* Importing a newly taken photo.
* Importing through the Apple Photos share menu.

None of these steps has resolved the issue. My Adobe cloud storage has 92.25 GB available out of 100 GB.

The problem started immediately after the update. Could you please investigate and help me restore editing functionality? I can provide screenshots and diagnostic logs.

reviews.title: Downgrade
reviews.text:
I fell in love with Lr the instant I came across it. Helped me take my work to a whole other level & made me fall in love with photography even more as I watched my photos transform. 

But the app has severely declined in quality as all apps do when tech giants prioritize profits above all else - user experience be damned. This shows quite clearly in the latest updates as several features & presets were deliberately stripped from the app. To say it was a disappointment would be an understatement, as those features helped me achieve the edits I wanted when my chronic illnesses & flareups impacted my vision and I couldn’t edit photos manually, or I was running between my day job, studies & hospital appointments and I had little time or energy to work on them. The app used to have strong options & versatility. You had more choices to reach the vision you had in mind and getting to explore what other community members had created would even inspire an entirely new idea or theme.

But now the options are meek, to put it lightly. Barely any options there at all. Honestly thought it was a bug at first, but went onto the forums only to discover it was not only a nightmare to navigate the platform and report any bugs at all, but also that the change was in fact a deliberate choice by the developer. Adobe’s response to the entire situation was even more disappointing.

reviews.title: Lightroom has become a joke
reviews.text:
I’ve used Lightroom since 2011, so I remember when there was no subscription fee. I remember when AI didn’t bog down the program. I remember when Lightroom actually worked well.

I hate sounding like an old grump (especially when I’m not that old) but adobe has driven their programs into the ground. 

My subscription used to cover both my iPad app and the phone— now it won’t cover both? What’s that about? And I updated the app, only to find the subscription price went from 6.99 to 7.99. What?! I was hoping after updating it’d let me restore my subscription to my phone, but their greed seems to know no bounds.

I hate the AI features, and I hate that you can’t opt out of your work being used in their AI. But it’s also a struggle finding similar tools that work the same way as some do in Lightroom. They know that. They lock you in on purpose, make you feel like this program is the only one worthwhile. It’s not worth much if the program lags the more AI is shoved into each feature and tool.

Hoping this subscription will be the final cycle once I transfer all my photos back onto my external hard drive. Lightroom is a disaster anymore. Save your money and avoid using it if possible. I know that’s hard when options these days are unfortunately limited, but it’s just not worth it. I’d give this 0 stars if I could.
